title: The Ark of the Covenant is taken by the Philistines
description: The Philistines defeat Israel at Ebenezer and capture the Ark of the Covenant. Eli's sons Hophni and Phinehas die in battle, and Eli himself falls backward from his chair, breaking his neck when he hears the news. Phinehas' wife gives birth to a son named Ichabod and says, "The glory has departed from Israel," before she herself dies.
